d: The New Chedi Ras Al Hadd | Sultanate of Oman

The New Chedi Ras Al Hadd is a 250-key eco-luxury resort on Oman’s spectacular eastern coast, owned by Ras Al Hadd Luxury Services SPC and operated under the GHM / The Chedi brand. With pre-opening operations planned from January 2027 and a grand opening targeted for September 2027, the resort will bring together understated luxury, exceptional hospitality, and the natural and maritime heritage of Ras Al Hadd.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Director of Housekeeping to lead the development and implementation of all housekeeping operations from pre-opening through to full resort operations.

Reporting to the Director of Rooms where applicable, you will be responsible for establishing the department, building a high-performing team, and ensuring that every guest room, villa, and public area reflects the distinctive quality, attention to detail, and understated elegance of The Chedi brand.
This is a key leadership role for a hospitality professional who combines strong operational expertise with a passion for service excellence, team development, and sustainable luxury.
q: A minimum of 10 years of housekeeping experience within luxury hospitality, including at least 3 years in a Director of Housekeeping or Executive Housekeeper role at a five-star hotel or resort.
Demonstrated experience in luxury resort pre-openings, preferably at a property of comparable scale and complexity.
Proven ability to establish housekeeping operations, recruit and develop teams, and deliver operational readiness against demanding opening deadlines.
Strong experience managing outsourced service providers, multicultural teams, and third-party contracts.
Excellent knowledge of housekeeping standards, laundry operations, linen management, OS&E, inventory control, budgeting, and cost management.
A hands-on leadership style, strong organisational skills, and exceptional attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, coaching, and team-development skills.
A degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or a related discipline is preferred.
Fluency in English is essential; Arabic language skills are an advantage.
Previous experience in Oman or the GCC is desirable.
r: li

li

li
Sustainability:Implement environmentally responsible housekeeping practices that support the resort’s eco-luxury positioning while maintaining the highest hygiene and quality standards.
li

x: The opportunity to shape the housekeeping function of a distinctive new luxury resort from the pre-opening stage.
A leadership position within an internationally recognised luxury hospitality brand.
A competitive remuneration and benefits package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
Professional growth and the opportunity to contribute to the long-term success of The Chedi brand.

d: Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

The British School of Bahrain (BSB) is a multi-award-winning school and one of the top international schools in Bahrain, educating children with demonstrable success for over 30 years. The school is rated “Outstanding” by Bahrain Quality Assurance (BQA) and British School Overseas (BSO).

The British School of Bahrain is renowned for offering the best holistic UK-based education within Bahrain. BSB’s core values of Excellence, Responsibility & Individuality underpin everything that we do and are epitomised by our three pillars of Academics, Sports and the Arts.

BSB delivers high-quality British education to around 2,600 students aged 3 to 18 years and employs 306 full-time staff representing 31 different countries who are carefully handpicked. BSB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check/ICPC or equivalent and satisfactory pre-employment references.

BSB is a vibrant and enjoyable place to work, and is renowned for its pedagogy, staff development and academic success. The value we place on individuality is evident in our inclusive and innovative teaching approach. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, with some adaptations to the local context and offers IGCSE, BTEC and A-Level examinations. Our aim is to provide our graduating students with a passport to the best universities, colleges and careers around the world.
We are seeking to appoint a Teacher of Humanities (Geography or History specialistm) to start in August 2027.
q: A degree and PGCE or B.Ed or the equivalent. The degree must be in the subject taught or a closely related subject
Experience teaching the British curriculum up to GCSE and A-level students is highly desirable
Confidence with the use of ICT in teaching
Enhanced disclosure from the DBS or equivalent, and who are committed to the welfare of all children
High expectations and aspirations for all students
A commitment to the overall development of young people
An open-minded approach to their work, and willing to learn and develop
A demonstrable love for what they do and a proven track record
To be considered for this position, you will need to meet our qualifications and experience requirements.

In return, we offer an attractive expatriate remuneration package, including a competitive tax-free salary, housing allowance, health insurance, annual flight and relocation assistance, and 2 free places for children.
